description: This line plot, titled "Ablation Study on HateXplain Dataset," illustrates the performance of a model across five configurations, measured by three evaluation metrics: Precision, Recall, and F1-score, all expressed as percentages on the y-axis. The x-axis represents the five model configurations, labeled from left to right as "Full model (Ours)", "w/o Prompt", "w/o Augmentation", "w/o Attention", and "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The y-axis, labeled "Metric (%)", ranges from 56 to 66 with major gridlines at integer intervals. The plot displays three distinct lines: a purple line with circular markers representing Precision, a blue line with circular markers for Recall, and a brown line with circular markers for F1-score. The purple Precision line begins at 65.49% for the "Full model (Ours)" and generally trends upward, reaching 65.44% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The blue Recall line starts at 65.49% for "Full model (Ours)", dips to 59.64% for "w/o Prompt", peaks at 62.63% for "w/o Augmentation", then declines to 56.82% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation". The brown F1-score line begins at 65.49% for "Full model (Ours)", falls to 60.16% for "w/o Prompt", rises to 62.22% for "w/o Augmentation", then decreases to 57.74% for "w/o Prompt & Augmentation".
